title: Operation: Quiet the Gateheart
premise: An ancient gate-maintenance commander interprets new relief shelters and civic repairs as unauthorized obstructions. It begins clearing the district according to obsolete law.

requiredSkillOptions.effect: Identify load-safe routes through the moving braces.
Read the rhythm of the Gateheart’s reset field.
Coordinate workers and refugees without turning them into combatants.

optionalRoute.benefit: Enter beside Resonance Pylon 1 and begin with one free Tactical setup.
optionalRoute.cost: The route is narrow; Wedge and Arrowhead formations begin with reduced Cohesion.

secondaryObjective.description: Disable three Resonance Pylons without destroying the relief power network.
ignoredEffects: Gate Reset repeats one round sooner
Support Union restores 8 MP per member each round
Post-battle repairs cost 80 additional Guild Treasury XP

eventDecision.choiceTheme: Preserve the maintenance crew’s records, overwrite them, or shut the terminal down.
eventDecision.futureHook: Preserved records reveal that the Warden was ordered to protect civic life, but its definition of authorized life has not been updated.

operationSequence.purpose: Teach objective-aware enemies and formation pressure.
Teach support protection and formation breaking.

bossArena.visual: A circular maintenance well around a suspended blue Gateheart, crossed by three service bridges and lined with relief power conduits.

enemyUnionWaves.trigger: Bastion Cohesion below 45 or all pylons disabled

telegraphs.name: Gate Reset
telegraphs.resolution: Heavy field damage and Cohesion loss; amplification equals active Pylon count.

telegraphs.name: Chain Recall
telegraphs.visibleText: MAINTENANCE UNITS // RETURN TO DESIGNATED POSTS
telegraphs.resolution: Pulls one exposed Union toward the center and restores an enemy formation.

opportunities.Guard: Intercept Gate Reset pressure and protect a Union disabling a Pylon.
opportunities.Restoration: Recover after field damage and cleanse Resonance Burn.
opportunities.Tactical: Split safely across service bridges, flank the Choir, or complete Pylon objectives.
opportunities.FormationBreak: Break the Bastion before it shields the Choir.
opportunities.LinkArt: Pylon setup and visible telegraphs make Guardian/Priest, Ranger/Mage, or full-Union Link Arts practical.

victoryConditions: Gateheart Warden Union broken or lawfully overridden
At least one player Union remains functional
bossArena.retreatRule: Retreat preserves discovered data, opens a recovery contract, and never deletes the campaign.

consequences.secondarySuccess: The relief district stays powered, repairs cost less, and workers join the Scout Network.
consequences.secondaryFailure: The Warden is stopped, but rebuilding consumes Treasury XP and some applicants begin with fatigue.
consequences.recordsPreserved: A later World Gate investigation gains a lawful maintenance route.
consequences.recordsDestroyed: The immediate override is easier, but the ancient civic record is permanently incomplete.
